name: Film 02 - DhlA SN2 QM/MM reaction path
description: First step of haloalkane dehalogenase DhlA (PDB 2DHC): Asp124 OD2 attacks C1 of 1,2-dichloroethane and chloride leaves (SN2). Relaxed QM/MM scan of the transfer coordinate xi = d(CL1-C1) - d(C1-OD2) from -1.6 to +1.6 A (13 points) with MOPAC PM7 embedded in Amber14; QM region = dichloroethane + Asp124 side chain (charge -1); the maximum is refined to the transition state.
